help_text:
📖 Help

Available commands:
/start — Start working
/help — Help

How to create a ticket:
1. Click "🆕 Start a new chat"
2. Describe your problem
3. AI assistant will answer your question
4. If you need an operator, type "operator" or "call a human"

Ticket number:
When creating a ticket, you will receive a 6-digit code. Save it to track status.

Support schedule:
Mon-Fri: 09:00-18:00
Sat-Sun: closed

If the bot does not answer — try /start
